Telephone Manager Message Functions / Clearing Message Handlers

TELClrTermMsgHand

Removes a terminal message handler from the Telephone Manager's calling list. 
pascal TELErr TELClrTermMsgHand (
                     TELHandle hTEL,
                     TelephoneTermMsgUPP msgProc);
hTEL
A handle to the telephone record for the terminal whose message handler you wish to clear. The telephone record is returned by the TELNew function or the TELNewWithResult function, and is described in "Telephone Record" on page 1-22.
msgProc
The terminal message handler you want to clear.
function result
A result code. See "Result Codes" on page 5-60 for a list of result codes that the Telephone Manager may return.
DESCRIPTION
The TELClrTermMsgHand function clears the terminal message handler specified by the msgProc parameter for the terminal specified by the hTEL parameter.
